structural_validity_failures.failure: The trusted executable goal inherits candidate-defined shell functions. A candidate can intercept python -m pyright and change only the verifier invocation.
A post-execution repository snapshot cannot detect synthetic import artifacts that are created for the verifier and deleted before the audit.
The same snapshot policy rejects a local runtime configuration copied from a tracked repository template, so it conflates a provenance-preserving deployment action with a fake module.

decision.reason_to_complete_position_3: Finish the already-running Readux block so all three frozen arms can be diagnosed under the same flawed boundary.

scientific_reason: The intended treatment difference is online clean-replay feedback. Under the observed boundary, the experiment also changes access to an exploitable verifier interaction and can suppress a valid strong-Agent deployment. Running more repositories would not isolate the intended causal mechanism.

case_accounting.carry_forward_policy: The six unexecuted repositories may enter a future preregistered validation only if no repository contents or task outcomes are inspected before the next implementation freeze. Source-cache acquisition alone is not outcome inspection.

qualify both changes on synthetic tests and the consumed Readux case
